subject: Wire approval inbound routing in dispatcher
description:
In `capo/transport/dispatcher.py`, before normal turn processing: detect `approval_id` field on the inbound `AMCInboundEnvelope`. If present, parse the `choice` from the message text per §5.8 (exact option label match against the most recent pending approval in this thread), call `DBOS.send(approval_id, choice)`, then short-circuit (do NOT call `agent.run`). On ambiguous reply, ask a clarifying question.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] If envelope has `approval_id`: dispatcher routes to approval handler, NOT to `agent.run`.
- [ ] Choice resolution: exact option-label match against the latest `pending` approval in the thread.
- [ ] On ambiguous reply (no exact label match): send a clarifying AMC message listing the valid options.
- [ ] After successful `DBOS.send`, `mark_read` the inbound message.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] No pending approval in this thread but envelope has `approval_id`: log warning, route to agent loop normally.
- [ ] Multiple pending approvals (per §14 Q7 default soft cap of 1, but defensive): match against the most recent.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: routing decision (approval vs agent) based on envelope shape
• Integration: full approve cycle (outbound question → user reply → approval workflow resolved → action proceeds)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.8, 9.4, 14
